design: Retrospective descriptive followup after E11 and E12 results were known. This protocol precedes E13 calculation, not the original study. No new source release is tested.
groups: Each year separately. Four equal count groups ordered by previous stock then municipality identifier within each year. Group boundaries describe these extracts, not universal stock categories.
persistence: Count years with gross >= 1% and net < 1% per municipality under the previous denominator. Also summarize each omission of one year. No independence or prospective validation claim.
weighting: For each year report the previous stock share in alerted records and sum(gross)/sum(before). This latter statistic is not the gross computed after national class aggregation.
verification: Reproduce E12 level1 counts and verify summary counts and weighted sums using CSV parsing and math.fsum without pandas.
limits: No causal attribution of residual differences
No map accuracy or confidence interval estimate
Denominator variants can agree because the two total stocks scarcely differ
Year and municipality records share sources and are not independent samples
No decision outcome or usability experiment
